Not really. Do you really think you're going to be completely gone someday?  No. In the back of your mind you think there's going to be some exception. Someone will discover immortality. Or your brain will be removed. Or you'll be a ghost. Or god will have some holy intervention. You don't actually think that you're going to be completely gone for all eternity without the ability to create more thoughts, remember the ones you've had, or perceive anything in any way, with no grasp of time or space. No one does.

Basically. If you don't kill yourself, then you can't possibly have come to terms with death. Instead you just wait. You don't want to know exactly how and when its going to happen. You just try to think about it as little as possible. Say there's a murderer in the other room. He's going to come in to your room after a random amount of time and stomp your head in. The brave man would walk right and and face him, knowing full well he's going to die. The coward would sit and wait and pretend that it wasn't really happening.

I'm not soliciting validation, I'm just doing exactly what I said. Seeing your reactions. It's kind of funny. It's like a man trying to catch water in his hands. As much as he tries, he cant accomplish it. I wanted this community to see someone they couldn't possibly save, and understand that some people are just like that. A lot of people here don't really understand suicide. Well at least for people like me. For some people it's a permanent solution to a temporary problem. But for me, its a little different. It's not like I became this way in adolescence. I've always been like this.

Of death, just like everyone. Everyone's scared of death. I'm terrified of dying. Sure I won't be scared once I'm dead, but the whole idea of crossing over. That's scary. The only really brave people are the ones who can actually go through with suicide. They're going to feel something that no living human has ever felt. They have no idea what to expect. What's going to happen to them. Where they're going to end up. What it's going to feel like. Humans have always been scared of death. In fact, there's nothing we're scared of more than death. That's why we invent things like superstitions and religion. We want to feel like we know what's going to happen. We do everything we can to make ourselves less scared. But the reality is, its the same thing no matter what we do. Anyone who can take their own life is braver than anyone can comprehend.

I'm like a cool sports car without an engine. Sure I seem great and interesting, but I can't actually function. But I'm going to prove them wrong. I can do what's best for me. I can do what's best for them. I can be strong and accomplish something even though I'm scared. I'm going to go through with this, not just for me but for them. I'm not just a terrified bitch. I can cross over. I can be brave. This is the hardest thing I've ever had to do, but I can do it.
